svg.title: Arrows into one place
svg.desc:
A · Suggested below - place: Welcome - affordance: What would you like to do? (copy) - affordance: Book a plot - affordance: Swap plots - affordance: Borrow tools from the shed - affordance: Leave the garden - place: Suggested - affordance: Plots that suit you (scribble) - affordance: Your name (field) - affordance: Go on - arrow: Book a plot → Suggested - arrow: Swap plots → Suggested - arrow: Borrow tools from the shed → Suggested - arrow: Leave the garden → Suggested
B · Suggested beside - place: Welcome - affordance: What would you like to do? (copy) - affordance: Book a plot - affordance: Swap plots - affordance: Borrow tools from the shed - affordance: Leave the garden - place: Suggested - affordance: Plots that suit you (scribble) - affordance: Your name (field) - affordance: Go on - arrow: Book a plot → Suggested - arrow: Swap plots → Suggested - arrow: Borrow tools from the shed → Suggested - arrow: Leave the garden → Suggested
